note: TEST ONLY: Jackson sinks replaced by Jackson 2.x equivalents for the fixture jars.

cves.summary_ko: 보안 제약(security-constraint) 경로 매칭에서, 같은 컬렉션 안에 긴 경로가 짧은 하위 경로보다 먼저 선언되면 더 엄격한 제약이 밀려나 접근 제어가 우회된다.
cves.summary_en: RealmBase.findSecurityConstraints() records the length of the LAST matching '/x/*' pattern in a web-resource-collection rather than the longest one. When a longer prefix is listed before a shorter overlapping prefix in one collection, a later constraint with an overlapping prefix can displace the more restrictive constraint, or be combined with it, and access is granted (NVD/CISA-ADP CVSS 9.1; Apache rates it Important).

l3.note: Only the /xxx/* pattern comparison, which runs only when security constraints are configured.

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat DIGEST 인증의 nonce count 재전송 창 계산 순서가 틀려, 창 상한값의 요청을 한 번 재전송할 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: DigestAuthenticator$NonceInfo.nonceCountValid() clears the 'seen' slot for the current count BEFORE incrementing it. A DIGEST request whose nc sits exactly at the upper boundary of the replay window therefore has its own seen-flag cleared and can be replayed once while that nc stays in the window. The same off-by-one also causes false rejections (NVD/CISA-ADP CVSS 9.8; Apache rates it Low).

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat FORM 인증 후 저장된 POST 요청을 복원할 때, GET 기준으로 계산한 보안 제약을 그대로 써서 POST 전용 제약이 우회된다.
cves.summary_en: With FORM auth, AuthenticatorBase.invoke() computes the security constraints for the post-login redirect GET. FormAuthenticator.restoreRequest() then swaps in the saved POST (method and body), and authorization runs against the stale GET constraints. If POST is role-restricted but GET is not, any user who can log in gets the POST processed without the required role (NVD/CISA-ADP CVSS 9.1; Apache rates it Low).

l3.note: Restoring the saved request method after FORM login.

cves.summary_ko: GOST R 34.13-2015 CTR 모드(G3413CTRBlockCipher)가 카운터의 마지막 1바이트만 증가시켜, 256블록 이후 키스트림이 반복된다.
cves.summary_en: G3413CTRBlockCipher, BC's GOST R 34.13-2015 CTR mode (algorithm name '<cipher>/GCTR'), increments only the last byte of the counter. After 256 blocks the counter wraps and the keystream repeats (two-time pad), leaking the XOR of plaintext blocks. Affects 1.59-1.80.1, 1.81 and 1.82-1.83, so the installed 1.81 is affected (fixed in 1.81.1).

l3.note: bcprov jars have no line numbers: whole method.

cves.summary_ko: 인증서 이름 제약(Name Constraints) 검사에서 rfc822Name·URI 호스트 끝의 점(.)을 정규화하지 않아, 제외 목록(excluded subtree)을 우회할 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: BC's PKIXNameConstraintValidator compares rfc822Name hosts/mailboxes and URI hosts against name constraints with a bare equalsIgnoreCase or a label split, without removing an RFC 1034 trailing dot. A leaf with SAN 'ceo@bank.com.' or 'https://competitor.example./' therefore escapes an excludedSubtrees entry for bank.com / competitor.example, and BC's PKIX CertPathValidator/CertPathBuilder accepts the chain. Affects all bcprov before 1.85, with no 1.81.x backport.

l3.note: bcprov jars have no line numbers: whole method. rfc822Name and URI checks only (shared DNS helpers are left out).

cves.summary_ko: ASN.1을 지연 파싱(lazyEvaluate)할 때, 지연된 SEQUENCE를 펼칠 때마다 중첩 깊이 제한이 초기화된다. 깊게 중첩된 입력을 끝까지 순회하면 StackOverflowError로 서비스가 멈춘다(DoS).
cves.summary_en: ASN1InputStream in lazy mode captures a SEQUENCE as LazyEncodedSequence; force()/getObjects() re-parse the contents with a fresh ASN1InputStream whose nesting-depth guard starts at the maximum again, so a crafted deeply nested SEQUENCE defeats the StreamUtil depth limit and a whole-tree walk overflows the stack (DoS). Fixed in 1.85 by carrying the remaining depth.

l3.note: bcprov jars have no line numbers: whole method.

cves.summary_ko: BouncyCastle LDAP 인증서 저장소가 인증서 DN에서 뽑은 값을 이스케이프하지 않고 LDAP 검색 필터에 넣어, 조작한 DN으로 필터를 바꿀 수 있다(LDAP 인젝션).
cves.summary_en: LDAP injection in BC's LDAP certificate store: LDAPStoreHelper and X509LDAPCertStoreSpi extract an RDN value from a certificate subject/issuer DN with parseDN and put it into an LDAP search filter without RFC 2254 escaping, so a crafted DN changes the filter. Affects 1.74-1.80.1, 1.81 and 1.82-1.83. The fix moves parseDN to LDAPUtils, which escapes * ( ) \\ and NUL.

l3.note: bcprov jars have no line numbers: whole method. X509LDAPCertStoreSpi.parseDN already escapes in 1.81.

cves.summary_ko: 숫자 문자열 검사 정규식(NumberInput.looksLikeValidNumber)의 백트래킹 때문에, 문자열로 들어온 값을 float/double/BigDecimal/Number로 변환할 때 CPU를 과도하게 쓴다(ReDoS).
cves.summary_en: ReDoS (CWE-1333/CWE-400) in NumberInput.looksLikeValidNumber(): the pre-validation regex PATTERN_FLOAT = [+-]?[0-9]*[.]?[0-9]+(...)? has adjacent quantifiers over the digit class, so a long run of digits that ultimately fails to match backtracks in O(n^2). jackson-databind calls this method during String-to-number coercion before any length limit applies, so a single long JSON string value bound to a number type pins a CPU thread (reporter measured ~74s for a 160,000-char string).
sources: source diff jackson-core-3.1.5 vs jackson-core-3.1.7 NumberInput.java + databind-3.1.5 call sites

l3.note: The regular expression match only.

cves.summary_ko: DataInput 기반 파서(UTF8DataInputJsonParser)가 오류 토큰 길이 제한을 적용하지 않아, 매우 긴 오류 메시지를 만든다.
cves.summary_en: Unbounded error-token growth (CWE-770/CWE-400) in UTF8DataInputJsonParser: its _reportInvalidToken() builds the error-message token in a loop that never checks ErrorReportConfiguration.getMaxErrorTokenLength() (default 256), unlike the InputStream/Reader parsers. A malformed token on a DataInput-backed parser is copied in full into the exception message, so a ~20M-char bogus token yields a ~20M-char message and can trigger OutOfMemoryError; no StreamReadConstraints setting mitigates it.
sources: source diff jackson-core-3.1.5 vs jackson-core-3.1.7 UTF8DataInputJsonParser.java

l3.note: The unbounded token loop.

cves.summary_ko: javax.xml.datatype Duration·XMLGregorianCalendar 역직렬화에 숫자 길이 제한이 없어, 큰 입력으로 CPU를 과도하게 쓴다.
cves.summary_en: CPU DoS (CWE-400) when binding a JSON string to a javax.xml.datatype.Duration or javax.xml.datatype.XMLGregorianCalendar field: CoreXMLDeserializers$Std._deserialize() passes the attacker string straight to DatatypeFactory.newDuration()/newXMLGregorianCalendar(), which parse numeric components with the O(n^2) BigInteger(String)/BigDecimal(String) constructors. The usual number-length limit is not applied, so a long digit run ties up a CPU thread for seconds to minutes.
sources: source diff jackson-databind-3.1.5 vs 3.1.6 CoreXMLDeserializers.java + StdDeserializer._validateTimestampLength

l3.note: Duration and XMLGregorianCalendar values (QName is not affected).

cves.summary_ko: 다형성 역직렬화에서 알 수 없는 type id가 기본 구현으로 대체될 때, type id 캐시가 제한 없이 커진다(메모리 고갈).
cves.summary_en: Memory-exhaustion DoS (CWE-400) via unbounded growth of the per-TypeDeserializer type-id cache. TypeDeserializerBase._findDeserializer() caches the resolved deserializer keyed by the raw, attacker-supplied type id in an unbounded ConcurrentHashMap (_deserializers). With name-based polymorphism plus a fallback (defaultImpl / problem handler), each distinct unknown id becomes its own permanent cache entry on a long-lived ObjectMapper, so a stream of unique ids grows the heap until OOM.
sources: source diff jackson-databind-3.1.5 vs 3.1.7 TypeDeserializerBase.java; call sites in AsProperty/AsArray/AsWrapperTypeDeserializer
local PoC on com.fasterxml jackson 2.16.1: 10000 distinct unknown Id.NAME ids retained 10000 entries in TypeDeserializerBase._deserializers

l3.note: Unknown type ids resolved by a problem handler or defaultImpl.

cves.summary_ko: @JsonIdentityInfo를 쓰는 컬렉션·맵에서 전방 참조가 많으면, 참조 해결이 제곱 시간이 걸린다.
cves.summary_en: Quadratic-complexity CPU DoS (CWE-400) in @JsonIdentityInfo forward-reference completion for Collection and Map deserializers. Unresolved object-id references are kept in an ArrayList and each resolution does a linear scan plus addAll merge; when N references are created and then their ids are defined in reverse order, completion costs O(N^2) (reporter measured ~2,003,000 ID comparisons at N=2000).
sources: source diff jackson-databind-3.1.5 vs 3.1.7 CollectionDeserializer.java / MapDeserializer.java / ObjectArrayDeserializer.java
local PoC on com.fasterxml jackson 2.16.1: reverse-order forward refs scale quadratically (683->3422->13798 ms for N=8k/16k/32k)

l3.note: The linear scan over pending forward references.

cves.summary_ko: java.nio.file.Path 역직렬화가 입력 URI의 스킴을 제한하지 않아, 외부 JSON이 등록된 아무 FileSystemProvider나 고르고 호출하게 할 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: The java.nio.file.Path deserializer passes an attacker-supplied string to new URI(value) and Path.of(uri), and on FileSystemNotFoundException walks ServiceLoader<FileSystemProvider> and calls getPath on the provider for the attacker-chosen scheme. Untrusted JSON can drive any registered FileSystemProvider during readValue. With only JDK providers the result is inert.

l3.note: URI-form paths only (plain file paths return earlier).

cves.summary_ko: @JsonTypeInfo의 기본 검증기가 java.lang.Comparable을 위험한 기반 타입으로 보지 않아, Comparable 타입 속성에 거의 모든 클래스(예: 임의 경로의 java.io.File)를 만들 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: DefaultBaseTypeLimitingValidator, the validator used for @JsonTypeInfo without a custom PolymorphicTypeValidator, did not treat java.lang.Comparable as an unsafe base type, so a @JsonTypeInfo property typed Comparable accepts almost any class (e.g. java.io.File with an attacker-chosen path). Global default typing is not affected (it requires an explicit validator).

l3.note: The fix changes deny-list data only, so execution alone cannot tell; the sink methods are reported as method evidence.

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat이 HTTP/2 요청의 헤더를 다 받은 뒤 필수 헤더를 확인할 때 호스트 이름(:authority 또는 host 헤더)이 없는 요청을 거르지 않는다. 호스트 이름과 TLS SNI를 맞춰 보는 검사(strictSni)는 호스트 이름을 읽을 때만 돌기 때문에, TLS 커넥터에서 HTTP/2를 켠 서버에 호스트 이름 없는 요청을 보내면 이 검사를 건너뛰고 요청이 처리된다.
cves.summary_en: org.apache.coyote.http2.Stream.receivedEndOfHeaders() accepts an HTTP/2 request (any method except CONNECT) that has :scheme and :path but neither :authority nor a host header. The strict SNI check (checkSni) runs only inside Stream.parseAuthority(), which is called when one of those headers arrives, so such a request skips the SNI/host-name comparison and is processed. The fix makes receivedEndOfHeaders() reject the request when the server name is not set.

sinks.note: The only method the three fix commits change. It runs for every HTTP/2 request once its headers are complete, so it is reachable whenever HTTP/2 is enabled; nothing narrower exists.

l3.note: No region: the fix adds one term (serverName().isNull()) to the required-header condition at Stream.java line 604, which every non-CONNECT HTTP/2 request evaluates. Executing that line does not show that a request without a host name was accepted, so the sink method is reported as method evidence only.

cves.summary_ko: FrodoKEM의 오차 표본 추출 코드(FrodoEngine.sample)가 비밀 값에 따라 분기해서 실행 시간이 달라진다. 공격자가 조작한 캡슐화 값을 여러 번 복호화(decapsulation)시키고 응답 시간을 재면 비밀 정보를 알아낼 수 있다. FrodoKEM을 쓰는 경우에만 해당한다.
cves.summary_en: FrodoEngine.sample(short), called for every matrix entry by FrodoEngine.sample_matrix, branches on the pseudo-random value it samples from (CDF table comparison and sign flip), so its running time depends on secret data. During FrodoKEM decapsulation (FrodoEngine.kem_dec) the sampled values derive from the decrypted message, which gives an attacker who submits encapsulations and measures timing a covert timing channel. Only FrodoKEM users are affected.

sinks.note: Private non-constant-time sampler removed by fix commit 94abbd5 (replaced by Noise.sample); this is the vulnerable code itself.
Only caller of sample; rewritten by fix commit 94abbd5. Called from kem_keypair, kem_enc and kem_dec, not only decapsulation.

l3.note: The 1.81 jar has no line numbers (every row of methods-installed.tsv has lines "-"), so the region is the whole method FrodoEngine.sample(short) (source lines 103-120, the secret-dependent branches are at 111-112 and 116-117). sample_matrix is left out because it only loops over sample. The region cannot tell decapsulation from key generation or encapsulation: sample also executes under kem_keypair and kem_enc, while the advisory limits the issue to decapsulation.

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat WebSocket 서버가 요청 경로를 엔드포인트 경로 템플릿({변수})으로 잘못 해석해, 요청 경로에 중괄호를 넣으면 다른 경로의 WebSocket 엔드포인트에 연결되면서 그 경로에 걸린 컨테이너 보안 제약(security-constraint)을 건너뛸 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: WsServerContainer.findMapping parses the request path as a URI template (new UriTemplate(path)), so a request path with {…} segments can match a templated WebSocket endpoint and bypass the security constraints on that endpoint.

sinks.note: Called by WsFilter only when JSR-356 endpoints are registered in the WsServerContainer and the request is a WebSocket upgrade.

l3.note: Line 290 parses the request path as a template; it runs for every WebSocket upgrade request with no exact endpoint match, so its execution does not show a path with {…} or a bypass.

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat이 OpenSSL을 FFM(Java의 외부 함수 호출) 방식으로 쓰면서 클라이언트 인증서 로그인(CLIENT_CERT)에 OCSP 확인을 켜고 soft-fail을 끈 경우, 인증서 상태를 확인하지 못했는데도 로그인이 실패하지 않을 수 있다. 취약한 코드는 tomcat-embed-core가 아니라 별도 jar(org.apache.tomcat:tomcat-coyote-ffm)에 있다.
cves.summary_en: With OpenSSL over FFM (org.apache.tomcat.util.net.openssl.panama.OpenSSLEngine.processOCSP, shipped in tomcat-coyote-ffm, not in tomcat-embed-core), an OCSP check that cannot complete does not fail CLIENT_CERT authentication even when soft fail is disabled.

sinks.note: Representative only: the fixed code (panama OpenSSLEngine.processOCSP) is not in tomcat-embed-core; the rule on the tomcat-coyote-ffm jar decides.

l3.note: The fixed code is in tomcat-coyote-ffm, not in this jar; nothing in tomcat-embed-core shows it ran.

cves.summary_ko: HTTP/2 요청 헤더를 풀 때(HPACK 허프만 해제) 허용되지 않는 문자를 만나면 예외로 중간에 멈추는데, 이때 헤더 해석 상태가 정리되지 않아 같은 연결의 다른 요청과 헤더가 섞일 수 있다. CVE-2026-41293 수정에서 들어온 회귀다.
cves.summary_en: HPackHuffman.decode (with isFieldName) throws IllegalArgumentException in the middle of an HPACK header block for an illegal character, a check added by the fix for CVE-2026-41293, which leaves the decoder state inconsistent and can mix request headers between requests.

sinks.note: Runs for every Huffman-encoded HTTP/2 header; the rule on HTTP/2 being enabled decides.

l3.note: The throw statements for an illegal character in a header name or value (both decoding branches). They run only for such input, so execution here is close to the attack, but it does not show that headers were mixed.

cves.summary_ko: Tomcat의 JNDIRealm(LDAP으로 로그인 확인)에 GSSAPI가 아닌 SASL 인증 방식을 설정하면, 사용자 비밀번호로 LDAP에 다시 붙어 확인하는 단계가 설정된 SASL 방식으로 그대로 진행돼 비밀번호가 틀려도 로그인이 통과할 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: JNDIRealm.bindAsUser keeps a configured non-GSSAPI SASL mechanism when it binds as the user to check the password, so the bind can succeed without the user's password and authentication fails open.

l3.note: Lines 1981-1982: the check that removes only GSSAPI before the bind; it runs for every bind-mode authentication, so its execution does not show a non-GSSAPI SASL mechanism is configured.

cves.summary_ko: HTTP/2로 받은 비동기 서블릿 요청(Spring MVC의 DeferredResult·Callable·SseEmitter 등)에서 처리 중 오류가 나면, Tomcat이 그 요청 상태를 오류로 보지 못하고 객체를 다시 써서 다른 사용자의 요청·응답과 섞일 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: AsyncStateMachine.isAsyncError ignores the MUST_ERROR state, so after an error during asynchronous processing of an HTTP/2 stream the request and response objects can be recycled and reused while still in use, mixing requests or responses between users.

sinks.note: Reached only through AsyncContextImpl (ActionCode.ASYNC_IS_ERROR), i.e. asynchronous servlet requests; HTTP/2 is required but not visible here.

l3.note: Line 220 runs whenever the async state is asked whether it is in error (any async request, HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2); its execution does not show HTTP/2 or an error.

cves.summary_ko: 응답 길이(Content-Length)를 정한 응답을 비동기(논블로킹) 방식으로 크게 쓰면, Tomcat이 아직 소켓에 다 보내지 못한 상태에서 응답을 닫아 응답 본문 일부가 같은 연결의 다음 요청 응답으로 넘어갈 수 있다. 다음 요청이 실패하거나 앞 응답의 데이터가 다른 사용자에게 보일 수 있다.
cves.summary_en: OutputBuffer.updateBytesWritten closes the response as soon as Content-Length bytes are counted, even for a non-blocking write whose bytes are still buffered at the socket, so the rest of the body can be sent as part of the next response on the connection.

sinks.note: Runs for every response write; only the non-blocking case (after setWriteListener) is vulnerable, so a rule decides.

l3.note: Line 447 is the condition the fix changed; it runs for every response write with a known Content-Length, blocking or not. Its execution does not show a non-blocking write.
